name: The Golden Horde: Story of Jambul
source: The first historical visual novel. 13th century - steppe, steel, and intrigue. Subedei and Jebe lead their armies westward, and it is up to you to decide: will history remain as written in the chronicles, or will you rewrite it anew?
translation: 第一部历史视觉小说。13世纪 - 草原、钢铁和阴谋。速不台和哲别率领大军西行，历史将继续如编年史中所写，还是重新书写，由你来决定？
